group_position: last shot of grp004 — Alice holds her map start (sitting_shelf, no path). CRE-001 runs his whole map line inside this shot: start meadow -> path sitting_shelf (within arm's reach of her shoes) -> end field_way.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: flat on her back at sitting_shelf; only her shoes and hem are in frame, in the near screen-left foreground
characters.space_fragment_en: lying on her back at the sister's sitting place, her shoes and hem filling the near foreground on screen-left, only her eyes moving
characters.facing: face up, unmoved; her eyes track the animal across her own feet

beats.action: her eyes catch the white shape entering from screen-right
beats.sync: the rabbit clears the long grass

beats.action: eyes swing left with him as he passes her shoes
eyes stay on the meadow after he has gone

performance_beat.objective: work out whether she has actually seen what she has just seen
performance_beat.goal: work out whether she has actually seen that
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from blank waking to a held, unspoken disbelief that never becomes a reaction shot

trigger.beat: the rabbit crosses within arm's reach of her shoes

no_early_reaction: the head lifting off the grass
forbidden_early: the head lifting off the grass
performance_beat.end_state: still flat on her back, eyes fixed down the meadow where he went, one slow blink, lips parted

creatures.label: Wild White Rabbit
creatures.start_pos: breaking out of the long grass of the meadow, entering from screen-right in the middle distance
creatures.space_fragment_en: standing on all fours out of the open meadow on screen-right, crossing the sister's sitting place toward the way across the field to the hedge
creatures.facing: head down the line of travel throughout — right to left across the near ground, then away down the meadow; never toward Alice, never toward the lens

path.to: within arm's reach of her shoes at the sitting place, at a flat gallop
bounding away toward the way across the field to the hedge

beats.action: passes her shoes without checking his stride
beats.sync: closest pass — no pause, no look

beats.action: turns away from camera and bounds off down the meadow

creatures.animal_discipline: Filmed as a real animal: true gait, true scale, no clothing, no pause, no look to camera and no look at Alice. He is the only bright white moving in the frame.

offscreen_presence.where: at the sister's sitting place, still reading
offscreen_presence.note: In the space, out of frame.
